title: Image + Markdown caption
description: Adds a `<figcaption>` under the image. Confirms that captions render as proper figure captions, distinct from surrounding prose.

data.markdown: Adding a `caption` field renders a `<figcaption>` underneath the image. Use captions for figure numbers, sources, attribution, and one-line context — anything longer belongs in the surrounding Theory section.

data.alt: Portrait crop of the 'Lena' test image, widely used in image-processing literature since the 1970s.
data.caption: Figure 2.1 — "Lena" (1972). One of the most-cited test images in image processing, originally cropped from a Playboy magazine photograph. Its mix of detail, texture, and smooth gradients made it a useful benchmark; modern surveys mostly avoid it on ethical grounds, but it still appears in older literature.
